Table 2 investment costs are in USD with NO YEAR stated; 2013_USD (publication year) is a flagged judgement - the cited sources date from 2008-2011. Production costs (Table 3, Figure 2, text) are in 2010 EUR per the Figure 2 caption (GDP deflators, 8000 h/yr); they are levelized and in a sidecar.

The brief's own header says Technology-Policy Brief I08 (January 2013); it is catalogued as I09. Main file: Table 2 (capex per t/yr, capacity) for four facilities as separate examples - Chemrec black liquor to DME+methanol (gasifier_black-liquor_motor-fuel), VarmlandsMetanol wood (gasifier_biomass_methanol-synthesis), CRI flue-gas CO2 + electrolytic H2 (reactor_hydrogen_methanol-synthesis) and the natural-gas reference plant (steam-reformer_natural-gas_methanol-synthesis); Table 3 (maximum single-plant capacity, LHV efficiency, non-renewable energy use, merged lifetime >25 yr and capacity factor 85%) for biomass (wood and by-product/waste streams as ONE example with two cases in square brackets), natural gas and CO2. Sidecars (not loaded): _no-archetype (coal-to-methanol: no archetype), _economics-and-market (levelized production costs in 2010 EUR, cost ratios, market and potential figures, electrolysis kWh/kg), _life-cycle-emissions (Table 3 GHG column and text - cradle-to-factory-gate, not Scope 1), _plant-list (Table 1). Figure 2 (scatter of production cost vs capacity) is not digitised. No flows: the brief gives no per-unit material or energy inputs apart from the aggregate 29-37 GJ/t.

(1) Header says Brief I08; catalogued as I09. (2) Table 2 CRI capital cost printed 9,500 USD/t/yr, but 15 million USD / 1.6 kt/yr = 9,375. (3) Chemrec's 100 kt/yr is combined DME and methanol (Table 1 footnote f), so Table 2's 4,400 USD/t/yr is not per tonne of methanol. (4) Table 2 gives no currency year. (5) Natural-gas production cost: EUR 100-250 (Table 3) vs 75-250 (p.6) vs 100-200 (p.1-2); CO2 route: 500-900 (Table 3) vs 510-900 (p.2, p.6). (6) Table 3 GHG values are rounded (0.6 for 0.64 and 0.56; 0.8 for 0.84) and are cradle-to-gate life-cycle values. (7) Table 1: BioMCN's capacity carries superscript 'a' where footnote b (upscaling to 400 kt/yr) is meant; footnote b has no marker. (8) Table 3's non-renewable energy use 29-37 GJ/t is a UNIDO figure for natural gas, petroleum products and coal together, including feedstock, but is printed in the natural-gas row. (9) The 200 kt/yr 'By-product/waste streams' maximum plant (BioMCN) runs on glycerine, not a gasified residue. (10) Lifetime and capacity factor are one merged cell in a block headed 'Data Projections'. (11) Two-line cells in Table 3 (e.g. '1,900 (Trinidad & / Tobago)') push the GHG values onto the next line in plain text.
